title: Using Machine Learning to Measure Self-Efficacy Belief Through Learners' Interaction Traces in Technology-Enhanced Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.41900v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-efficacy beliefs play a critical role in learners' performance, academic choices, and, more broadly, in their future career trajectories. As Technology-Enhanced Learning (TEL) environments have demonstrated strong potential for supporting both performance and motivation, investigating self-efficacy within such environments is of particular interest, especially for implementing remedial practices as early as possible to support learners' self-efficacy beliefs. Our research aims to develop a system capable of detecting low self-efficacy based on learners' interaction traces while they solve exercises in a TEL system. In this paper, we present initial results and future perspectives on a detection approach based on data mining and machine learning techniques to identify features indicative of low self-efficacy beliefs. Because the detection of learners' self-efficacy beliefs through their use of TEL systems remains largely unexplored,

translated_title: 利用机器学习通过学习者在技术增强学习环境中的交互轨迹测量自我效能信念
translated_abstract: 自我效能信念在学习者的表现、学业选择，以及更广泛地说，在他们未来的职业轨迹中发挥着关键作用。由于技术增强学习（TEL）环境已展现出在支持学习表现和动机方面强大的潜力，因此在这类环境中研究自我效能具有特别的意义，尤其是为了尽早实施补救措施以支持学习者的自我效能信念。我们的研究旨在开发一个能够在学习者在TEL系统中解题时，基于其交互轨迹检测低自我效能的系统。在本文中，我们展示了一种基于数据挖掘和机器学习技术的检测方法的初步结果和未来展望，该方法旨在识别能够指示低自我效能信念的特征。由于通过学习者对TEL系统的使用来检测其自我效能信念在很大程度上仍未被探索，
tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于数据挖掘和机器学习技术的方法，通过分析学习者在技术增强学习系统中解题时的交互轨迹来检测和识别低自我效能信念，开辟了一个基本未被探索的研究领域。
en_tdlr: This research proposes a detection approach based on data mining and machine learning techniques to identify low self-efficacy beliefs from learners' interaction traces while solving exercises in Technology-Enhanced Learning environments, opening up a largely unexplored research area.
